name: dataflash_ch582
description: CH582 internal flash serial-command interface used for DataFlash and factory-row access.

sources.reference: CH582M erase, program, readback, factory-row, and PFIC-reset persistence observations
sources.note: Applies to the recorded CH582M target and exact standalone DataFlash cases.

registers.name: DATA_WORD
registers.description: Four-byte receive window for the internal flash serial interface.

registers.name: DATA
registers.description: Byte input/output port for command, address, dummy, and payload bytes.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Serial-interface enable and busy state. Bit 7 remains set while the controller cannot accept the next byte.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: The current byte transfer is still in progress.

registers.name: FLASH_CFG
registers.description: Flash execution timing configuration used during system-clock handoff.
